description: Type definitions and function declarations for a linked list data structure involving nodes with keys and values. It defines types for ListNode and RootNode, and functions for getting, setting, checking, and deleting nodes in the list.

methods.name: export function listGetNode<T, K>(list: RootNode<T, K>, key: ListNode<T, K>['key'], isDelete?: b/ listGetNode
methods.description: Retrieves a node from the list by key, optionally for deletion.

methods.name: listGet
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a key from the list.

methods.name: listSet
methods.description: Sets or updates the value for a given key in the list.

methods.name: listHas
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the list.

methods.name: listDelete
methods.description: Removes a node identified by key from the list.
